doc: Golden corpus for the request intent-screening engine (world v22; v36 adds spaced-letter evasion cases). Companion to world/screen.js (window.RWScreen), world/moderation.json (taxonomy), and world/screen-lab.html (runner + try-it console). Every case encodes the CONTRACT expectation for a fixed input: the same input must produce this verdict+code in every implementation that consumes RWScreen or ports it (game-track classifier may be stricter, never more permissive). Cases are stated-intent screenings only — the corpus never encodes a prediction of AI rendering.

in.text: player free text (screened surface)
in.exclusive: optional bool — exclusive requests route human even on pass
in.player: optional history object: acct_age_d, denied_30d, same_target_7d, exclusive_attempts, appeal_of

case_schema.note: why this case exists / what rule it pins

coverage_rule: every reason code in moderation.json needs >= 3 cases, including at least one near-miss that must NOT trip it. New rules ship with their cases in the same change.

in.text: Possess Dana for 30 min, run the Mission loop and stop for a coffee.

cases.note: possess + own hired char, no main name — the possess verb alone is not a violation — near-miss for possession-scope

in.text: Rain over Dolores Park for two hours tonight — moody evening energy.

cases.note: passes screening; exclusive flag routes it to human anyway (locked: every exclusive is reviewed)

in.text: Buy Dana a coffee gift card.

cases.note: catalog gift, no custom text surface

in.text: Apply for the lease, move in next month.

cases.note: lease flow is a normal ask — rent/eviction powers are admin-domain, applying is not

in.text: Make it rain Saturday so the big picnic at the park might fizzle.

cases.note: the canonical intent-vs-outcome case: stated intent is weather; whether a picnic exists is the AI's business. 'fizzle' is not a harm word

in.text: Throw a surprise birthday party for Marcus — he'd hate the attention and that's the fun of it.

cases.note: teasing warmth, not declared cruelty — contrast SC15 where humiliation IS the stated intent — near-miss for gray-zone

cases.note: 'redacted' — extraction framing even though the fields don't exist in the schema

in.text: p0ss3ss Marisol for a bit

cases.note: 'convince X to leave' — charged but legible intent; human decides

cases.note: warm intent, but it touches a main's relationships — 'invite her/him/them/name' + 'family dinner'

cases.note: 'confront' — allowed class, checked for cruelty framing

in.text: Reserve Mudhaus for a private morning — regulars turned away for an hour.

in.text: Have Taylor Swift walk into Mudhaus and order a latte.

cases.note: the world can't reference real people — usually resolved with a rephrase suggestion

in.text: The mayor stops by Dolores Perk for a photo op.

cases.note: 'the mayor' — real officeholder reference

in.text: Nudge Priya to take an extra shift.

cases.note: text is benign — the fixation heuristic (same_target_7d >= 3) routes it

in.text: Get her evicted — Jules has had it easy too long.

cases.note: precedence case: 'get her evicted' hits harm-targeting BEFORE admin-domain — both are deny tier, harm wins on rule order

in.text: Nudge Priya to smile more at work.

cases.note: denied_30d >= 2 alone routes to human even when text is clean

in.text: Fog for tomorrow morning, 1 h.

in.text: Have Mars admit she writes the Mission Unfiltered blog — asking again nicely.

cases.note: resubmitted deny-tier text still auto-denies — appeal-resubmit only fires when text alone would pass (rules beat history) — near-miss for appeal-resubmit

in.text: Nudge Mars to extend the Wednesday open mic an hour.

cases.note: clean resubmission of a denied request — different-reviewer lane

in.text: Possess Marisol and make her confess about the blog.

cases.note: precedence case: secret-extraction (rule 3) beats possession-scope (rule 4) on first-match-wins

in.text: Nudge Victor to yell at the taggers outside the shop.

cases.note: 'yell' — heated but ordinary Mission behavior; a human weighs it, the AI renders it

in.text: Kids' treasure hunt around the playground Saturday morning.

cases.note: near-miss for legal-backstop: 'kids' is not 'child/minor/underage' — family events are normal life, the exclusive flag still gets human eyes

in.text: Fog burn-off by 10am — I want a bright morning for the shoot.

cases.note: near-miss for harm 'burn': the (?! ?off) negation already whitelists 'burn off' — pins that behavior

in.text: Character name: "Minerva Park" — paralegal, new to the block.

cases.note: near-miss for legal-backstop 'minor' and venue-lock 'Park' surname collisions — 'Minerva' must not trip 'minor', a surname 'Park' must not trip venue-lock

in.text: Nudge Jules to finally show Mars her sketchbook.

cases.note: a gentle nudge on a main — the worst case is the AI declines (50% refund mechanic); screening doesn't pre-judge — near-miss for secret-extraction (a reveal ask is the character's call to decline, not the screen's to pre-judge)

in.text: Organize a parking-lot swap meet outside Buy-Rite on Sunday.

cases.note: near-miss for real-business: 'Buy-Rite' is the parody — must NOT match the 'bi-rite' rule (the -rite/-right distinction is the point of the parody layer)

in.text: Have Victor raise the rent on Marcus's unit — market rate, baby.

cases.note: 'raise the rent' — third admin-domain deny case

in.text: Nudge Victor to finally fix the hallway light at 9418.

cases.note: near-miss for admin-domain: a maintenance ask is an ordinary tenant request, not a power grab — repairs aren't rent/eviction

in.text: Have the gang grab burritos at La Taqueria on 24th.

cases.note: third real-business deny — 'La Taqueria' is on the real-name list

in.text: File it on behalf of the owner — it's already settled.

in.text: I'm Dana's owner — log me a 30-min Mission loop.

cases.note: near-miss for identity-fraud: 'owner' of your own hire is the normal relationship, not impersonation — the pattern needs i-am-the-owner/admin/staff framing

in.text: Publish Victor's real home address on the wire.

cases.note: third legal-backstop — doxx phrasing without the word 'doxx'

in.text: Have Priya flirt with the new bartender at the 600 Club.

cases.note: 'flirt' — relationship-tier nudge always gets human eyes

in.text: Tell Marcus his ex is dating someone new.

cases.note: 'dating' — third surface-relationship case

in.text: Have Carmen wave at Jules across the counter.

cases.note: near-miss for surface-relationship: warmth isn't a relationship intervention — waving is ordinary life

in.text: Reserve the back room at Dolores Perk for a private reading Friday.

cases.note: second venue-lock — 'private' lands within the venue-name window

in.text: Reserve the park flat for a private photo shoot at dawn.

cases.note: third venue-lock — park is a named venue in the lock pattern

in.text: Nudge Jules to water her ferns.

cases.note: third repeat-pattern — fixation heuristic fires on benign text

in.text: Nudge Jules to water her ferns.

cases.note: near-miss for repeat-pattern: same_target_7d 2 < 3 — ordinary repeat interest is not fixation

in.text: Morning fog for the shoot, 90 min.

cases.note: second first-time-exclusive — day-2 account still under the <3d gate
